channel.title: Simple Product Picks - USB-C Cables UK
channel.description: Buying guides for USB-C charging cables. Every link verified against the live Amazon listing.

item.title: Best USB C Cable For Fast Charging 2026
item.description: A cable has to carry the power your charger negotiates. Three USB-C leads rated on wattage, braid quality and the length that suits your desk.

item.title: Best USB C Cable For iPhone 15 2026
item.description: USB-C leads worth pairing with an iPhone 15: a braided everyday cable, a short two-pack and one USB4 lead. Three picks compared on power and data.

item.title: Best Thunderbolt 4 Cable 2026
item.description: Not every USB-C lead carries the full 40Gbps. Three Thunderbolt 4 and USB4 cables for desks, compared on certified speed, charging wattage and length.

item.title: USB4 vs Thunderbolt 4 Explained 2026
item.description: USB4 vs Thunderbolt 4, explained: both share the USB-C port and a 40Gbps ceiling, so the difference is which features are guaranteed.

item.title: USB-C Cables That Carry Video
item.description: A USB-C cable carries video only if it's built for DisplayPort Alt Mode, USB4 or Thunderbolt. How to read the label, and why a charge-only lead shows nothing.

item.title: Thunderbolt 4 Cable Length Limits
item.description: A Thunderbolt 4 cable holds the full 40Gb/s up to 2 metres; only past that do you need an active cable. Why the old Thunderbolt 3 length trap no longer bites.
